field_task_overview: Provide a brief meeting description, including its purpose, intended audience, coordinators or contacts, and any other key details.
For help preparing your Overview, please use our [Meeting Overview Template](https://events.cancer.gov/sites/default/files/assets/templates/Overview_Page_Template.docx).
field_task_agenda: [Learn more about the two types of agenda formats we offer](https://events.cancer.gov/demo/event/agenda).
field_task_web_banner: Size must be 1170 pixels width and no taller than 350 pixels in height, file format must be either .png or .jpg and file size should not exceed 1 MB
field_task_vami_contact_email: For events held at NIH or Shady Grove, provide the email address of the federal employee who will attend the meeting on-site and enter non-citizen information into the VAMI application.
field_task_registration: Review the text and fields, submit a test registration, and provide a deadline for registrants. [Learn more about Registration Forms](https://events.cancer.gov/demo/event/registration).
field_task_registration_confirm: Use our [Confirmation Web Page and Email Template](https://events.cancer.gov/sites/default/files/assets/templates/Registration_Confirmation_Templates.docx). To test, submit a test registration and provide any additional edits or feedback.
field_task_calendar_invite: Request an .ics Calendar Invite from the [AV Conference Support](mailto:NCICRHelp@mail.nih.gov) and upload it below.
field_task_abstract: Review text and fields, submit a test submission and provide a deadline for submissions.
field_task_abstract_confir: Submit a test submission to see this page, provide any custom edits to the text.
field_task_speaker_bio_web_form: Provide a contact email and submission deadline for speakers to send their headshots. The designated contact will be responsible for uploading the headshots to the web form.
field_task_poster_submission: Review text and fields, submit a test submission and provide a deadline for submissions.
field_task_poster_sub_confirm: Submit a test submission to see this page, provide any custom edits to the text.
